On top of this, I absolutely hate blood tests since having some bad ones over the years where I have developed a slight phobia, twice at this practice I’ve been fortunate to see  Annie, who is easily the best blood taker I have EVER had, she is SO skilled at what she does, she was so kind and put me at ease, this practice is so lucky to have her!!!

Lastly, I think one time I had a nurse called Audrey who gave me a Hep A vaccination and she spent so much time with me giving me travel advice and again, she knew I was anxious about having a vaccination and she was so skilled and kind and I think I’ve seen her interaction with other patients and she seems very caring.
